content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides a link while referencing earlier-round sections and verses, so the K-G4 counting rule is in scope.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.
